tasks.title: Handoff scaffolding self-audit (POLICY_LOCK + scripts + docs)
tasks.description:
Review the handoff pack files already present in the repo and ensure:
- POLICY_LOCK is consistent across docs and scripts
- scripts paths and commands are correct
- tasks.json verification commands reference scripts/commands.sh and env.sh
If any mismatch is found, fix it within scope. Otherwise, no-op changes.
acceptance_criteria: No contradictions between POLICY_LOCK (ADR) and scripts/commands.sh
tasks/tasks.json verification_commands reference scripts/commands.sh (no raw python/python3)
No extra checkpoints beyond P0-999

tasks.title: Scaffold Python project (pyproject + src layout packages)
tasks.description:
Create the initial Python project scaffold with src-layout and top-level packages:
- deposim_schema
- deposim_sim
- deposim_report

Include minimal __init__.py and versioning, and a basic tests skeleton.
Keep file count minimal and avoid adding optional heavy dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: src/ contains deposim_schema, deposim_sim, deposim_report packages with __init__.py
pyproject.toml exists and supports editable install
Basic import test exists under tests/
verification_commands: bash -lc 'test -d src/deposim_sim && test -d src/deposim_schema && test -d src/deposim_report'

tasks.title: Implement deposim_schema: structured configs + YAML/Hydra composition for sim
tasks.description:
Implement the simulation configuration schema in deposim_schema, using dataclasses
(Hydra Structured Config) with validation and clear defaults.

Requirements:
- YAML-based configuration for sim, composed by Hydra.
- Separate config roots for sim/ and opt/ (opt may remain stub for now).
- Include DomainSpec, ReferencePlaneSpec, TimeSpec, InputsSpec, DriversSpec, ModelSpec,
  SolverSpec, ComputeSpec, OutputSpec, and RunSpec.

Provide an example sim config under configs/sim/ that can run on synthetic inputs later.
acceptance_criteria: Structured config dataclasses exist for sim config, importable from deposim_schema
configs/sim/example_cvd.yaml exists (or equivalent) with clear parameters
Config can be composed and saved as resolved YAML

tasks.title: Implement domain grids and masks (wafer_2d_polar + wafer_1d_radial)
tasks.description:
Implement domain/grid generation for:
- wafer_2d_polar (r, theta)
- wafer_1d_radial (r)

Include:
- coordinate arrays, spacing, area weights if needed
- edge exclusion mask support
- mapping utilities needed for report (radial profile)

Keep implementation minimal and numeric-library agnostic (NumPy first).
acceptance_criteria: DomainSpec can generate a grid object with r/theta arrays
Masking supports edge exclusion in mm
Unit tests cover basic grid shape and mask behavior

tasks.title: Model registry + mass transfer models (stagnant film, rotating disk w/ omega guard)
tasks.description:
Implement model registry for mass transfer models and provide at least:
- stagnant_film: km = D / delta_eff
- rotating_disk (Levich-like scaling): km ~ Ck * D^(2/3) * omega^(1/2) * nu^(-1/6)

Add omega=0 guard behavior:
- configurable: error OR fallback to stagnant_film

km must accept scalar or spatial fields and return km aligned to domain grid.
acceptance_criteria: Mass transfer registry resolves model by name from config
rotating_disk guard on omega=0 is implemented (error/fallback configurable)
km output shape matches domain grid

tasks.title: Rate laws (powerlaw + saturation/inhibition) with apparent order diagnostics
tasks.description:
Implement rate law models in registry:
- powerlaw: r = k(T) * Π Cs_i^n_i (allow negative/fractional n)
- saturation_inhibition: denominator form enabling order transitions and inhibition

Implement:
- stable log evaluation
- apparent order computation n_app = d ln r / d ln C (analytical if possible)

Ensure rate laws accept Cs dict + state + T arrays.
acceptance_criteria: Rate law registry resolves model by name from config
powerlaw supports negative/fractional orders robustly
apparent_orders returns maps consistent with analytical expectations for these models

tasks.title: Transport–reaction coupling solver: vectorized bisection on progress variable R
tasks.description:
Implement the core coupled solver for the single-dominant-reaction case:

- Reduce to scalar root solve F(R)=0 with physical bracket [0, R_max]
- Provide vectorized bisection solver (NumPy baseline)
- Track iteration counts and status flags per grid point

Add monotonicity/shape check for F(R):
- detect potential non-monotonic cases (sample points)
- define fallback behavior (warn + optional interval split OR controlled failure)

Ensure C_s is computed from R and clipped/guarded to nonnegative values for forward sim.
acceptance_criteria: solve_progress_R returns R, Cs, iteration_count, status_map
Nonnegativity constraints are enforced (Cs>=0, R within bracket)
Monotonicity check exists and produces an explicit status/warning

tasks.title: CVD steady simulator: thickness + diagnostics (Cs/Cref, Da proxy, n_app)
tasks.description:
Implement a CVD steady forward simulator that:
- accepts FieldBundle (C_ref species, U, T, scalars like P, omega)
- builds km via mass-transfer model
- solves for Cs via TCRSK solver (progress-variable root)
- computes deposition rate and thickness for process_time

Must output standard diagnostics:
- thickness map
- Cs/Cref map(s)
- Da proxy (define and document)
- apparent order maps (from RateLaw)
- root iteration counts/status
acceptance_criteria: run_cvd_steady returns thickness + diagnostics as arrays aligned with domain grid
Diagnostics include Cs/Cref, Da proxy, apparent orders, solver health
Sign conventions documented (deposit positive)

tasks.title: RunManager + outputs + plots + HTML report with fixed results/index.html entrypoint
tasks.description:
Implement output management:
- create results/ with fixed entrypoint results/index.html
- create run_id subdir with:
  - config_resolved.yaml
  - outputs/ (arrays; NPZ baseline is acceptable for P0)
  - plots/ (matplotlib images)
  - report.html (links + summary)

Add standard plots:
- thickness map
- radial profile
- Cs/Cref map
- Da proxy map
- apparent order map(s)
- solver iteration/status map

Also record summary.json with key metrics.
acceptance_criteria: results/index.html exists and links to latest run report
Run directory contains resolved config, arrays, plots, report.html
No file explosion; outputs are organized deterministically

tasks.title: Synthetic input generator + smoke entrypoint (Hydra config) used by scripts/commands.sh
tasks.description:
Create a deterministic smoke run path that does not require real CFD input formats:

- synthetic FieldBundle generator with configurable patterns (e.g., radial gradients)
- a module entrypoint `python -m deposim_sim.smoke` (or equivalent) that:
  - composes config via Hydra
  - runs CVD steady simulation on synthetic inputs
  - writes outputs via RunManager

Ensure scripts/commands.sh smoke uses this entrypoint.
acceptance_criteria: Running ./scripts/commands.sh smoke produces a new run under results/runs/<run_id>
Synthetic input is deterministic for reproducibility
Smoke run uses Hydra-composed YAML config

tasks.title: Unit tests + P0 verify gate wiring (import_check, smoke, tests)
tasks.description:
Add unit tests (use stdlib unittest to avoid extra dependencies) covering:

- root bracket and nonnegativity: Cs>=0, R in [0,Rmax]
- regime limits: transport-limited vs reaction-limited sanity
- rotating-disk omega=0 guard behavior (error/fallback)

Wire scripts/commands.sh:
- import_check
- test
- verify_p0 (import_check + smoke + test)

Make sure docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL.md matches commands.
acceptance_criteria: ./scripts/commands.sh verify_p0 passes
Tests are deterministic and fast
EVAL_PROTOCOL commands are accurate

tasks.title: Repo-wide consistency sweep (commands, docs, old names) [review]
tasks.description:
Review the entire repo for consistency:
- no stale package names
- commands.sh is the only source of run/test commands
- docs reference correct commands
- no unintended extra checkpoints
- ensure results/ and runs/ are gitignored

Fix minor inconsistencies within scope.
acceptance_criteria: No stale run/test commands outside scripts/commands.sh
Docs match actual code entrypoints
.gitignore includes runs/ and results/
verification_commands: bash -lc 'grep -R "python3 -m" -n docs scripts tasks | head -n 50 || true'

tasks.title: P0 CHECKPOINT: run verify_p0, summarize status, stop
tasks.description:
Run the P0 verification gate and summarize:

- commands run and results
- what features are implemented (vs planned)
- next P1 tasks readiness
- any known limitations

Write summary to a markdown file under runs/ (or docs/) and stop.
acceptance_criteria: verify_p0 passes
A checkpoint summary is written
Autorun stops with exit code 42 after this task

tasks.title: DOE runner (grid/random) with case-dimension outputs (no directory explosion)
tasks.description:
Implement DOE/sweep execution:
- grid and random sweep specs (YAML-controlled)
- execute N cases without per-case deep directories
- store outputs as case-dimension arrays (NPZ ok; Zarr optional later)
- produce a DOE summary report (metrics table + plots)

Respect user-selected compute settings; do not force CPU/GPU choices.
acceptance_criteria: DOE run produces a single run directory with case-dimension outputs
No per-case directory explosion
Summary metrics (uniformity, center-edge etc.) are produced

tasks.title: z_ref sensitivity workflow (as DOE factor + report)
tasks.description:
Add a standardized workflow to assess sensitivity to reference-plane height z_ref:

- treat z_ref as a sweep parameter
- compare thickness and diagnostics across z_ref values
- report sensitivity metrics and plots

This is critical to detect z_ref fragility in practical usage.
acceptance_criteria: Config supports sweeping z_ref
Report includes z_ref sensitivity plots/metrics

tasks.title: Additional kinetics + net models (competition/LHHW, dep-etch-loss composition)
tasks.description:
Extend the model registry with:
- a competition/LHHW-like reduced kinetics model
- a net model that composes deposition, etch, and loss channels with consistent sign conventions

Keep the core TCRSK solver stable; if multi-channel breaks scalar-R reduction, document limitations and
gate the advanced path behind config flags.
acceptance_criteria: New rate law and net model are selectable via YAML
Diagnostics remain available (n_app, Cs/Cref, solver health)

tasks.title: MeasurementAdapter skeleton (2D map alignment + masks)
tasks.description:
Implement a measurement adapter skeleton to support later assimilation:

- coordinate alignment (center shift dx,dy; rotation theta0)
- edge exclusion masks
- resampling from measurement grid to simulation grid (basic interpolation)

Do not implement full assimilation yet; focus on robust preprocessing utilities.
acceptance_criteria: MeasurementAdapter can align and mask a 2D thickness map
Unit tests cover basic alignment/masking behavior

tasks.title: Optional JAX engine path (CPU first) for core solver and rate laws
tasks.description:
Add an optional JAX backend (CPU first):

- keep NumPy baseline as default
- implement JAX versions of bisection loop (fixed iteration) and rate laws
- add engine selection via YAML
- add parity tests (NumPy vs JAX CPU on synthetic case)

JAX should be an optional extra dependency, not required for P0 gate.
acceptance_criteria: JAX engine can run a smoke case on CPU when installed
NumPy and JAX results match within tolerance
Engine selection respects user YAML choice

tasks.title: Benchmark helper (reports throughput; does not override user choice)
tasks.description:
Add a benchmark mode:
- run representative cases under NumPy, JAX-CPU, JAX-GPU (if available)
- report runtime and throughput
- DO NOT auto-switch compute settings; only report suggestions

Benchmark outputs should go to results/ like other runs.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark mode produces a report with timings
No automatic override of user compute settings

tasks.title: Create deposim_opt package scaffold (configs/opt split) with parameter transforms
tasks.description:
Create deposim_opt as a separate package for assimilation/optimization.

Include:
- config schema for opt (YAML under configs/opt)
- parameter transforms (exp for positive, sigmoid for bounded, etc.)
- robust loss functions (Huber) and regularization utilities

Do not couple deposim_sim to deposim_opt.
acceptance_criteria: deposim_opt imports successfully (when installed)
Opt config is separate from sim config

tasks.title: Assimilation minimal loop on synthetic data (CPU) [no heavy deps required]
tasks.description:
Implement a minimal parameter estimation workflow on synthetic thickness maps:

- choose a small set of parameters (e.g., k0, Ck)
- define an objective between simulated thickness and synthetic measurement
- optimize using SciPy (baseline) to avoid requiring JAX

Ensure constraints are handled smoothly in opt mode (avoid hard clip causing zero gradients).
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic assimilation reduces loss from initial guess
Results and fitted params are saved to results/ with report

tasks.title: ALD phases + state model skeleton (coverage) with stiff-safe solver choices
tasks.description:
Add ALD support:

- TimeSpec mode 'phases' with per-phase durations and input bindings
- State models (coverage) with bounded constraints [0,1]
- Prefer analytic updates when possible; else allow stiff-safe implicit solver options
- Connect thickness-per-cycle accumulation

This is staged; focus on stable skeleton and tests.
acceptance_criteria: ALD phases mode runs a synthetic example
Coverage stays within [0,1]

tasks.title: ClearML integration as optional leaf package (no core dependency)
tasks.description:
Add optional ClearML integration package:

- separate package with minimal hooks to log config, metrics, artifacts
- deposim_sim must not import ClearML
- integration should be opt-in

Add docs describing how to enable.
acceptance_criteria: Core simulation imports without ClearML installed
ClearML integration is optional and documented

tasks.title: IO plugin system for CFD fields and measurement maps (CSV/NPZ baseline)
tasks.description:
Implement IO plugins for ingesting real-world data:

- FieldBundle loader interface
- at least NPZ and CSV loaders for fields and measurements
- keep schema stable and validate units/shapes

Do not bake in a single CFD format; make loader selection configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Config can select an IO loader by name
Basic loaders work on simple sample files

tasks.title: Zarr output option for large DOE (keep NPZ fallback)
tasks.description:
Add an optional Zarr output backend:

- store thickness/diagnostics with case dimension efficiently
- keep NPZ as fallback
- gate Zarr behind optional dependency
acceptance_criteria: Zarr output works when dependency installed
NPZ remains default/fallback

tasks.title: Multi-z reference-plane support (optional) + diagnostics
tasks.description:
Add optional support for multiple CFD reference planes:

- accept C(z) at multiple z_ref
- provide diagnostics (z-slope, inferred boundary-layer indicators)
- allow correction of C_ref to an 'effective bulk' metric (configurable)

This is advanced; keep behind flags and do not break existing single-plane mode.
acceptance_criteria: Single-plane mode remains unchanged
Multi-plane mode runs on synthetic example and outputs diagnostics

tasks.title: Final consistency sweep (docs/commands/tasks) [review]
tasks.description:
Review the repo for consistency across all milestones:
- docs vs code vs commands
- tasks traceability completeness
- no stale names
- ensure optional deps are properly optional
acceptance_criteria: Repo is internally consistent and traceability remains 100%
